sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered layer-color sequence and its input-determined output side length.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read one color from each uniform row and remove the final duplicated center-evidence row.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Assign each square cell the color indexed by its minimum distance from an edge, reversing the sequence only for inside_out.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The renderer has neither a side length nor ring colors without the extracted sequence; input width contributes no usable shortcut.
